paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for three different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale with values ranging from 2.5 to 12.5, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale with values ranging from 24 to 31, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines: a blue line with circle markers and a solid style representing "Inconsistency-CE", an orange line with triangle markers and a dashed style representing "Consistency-Bi +sampling", and a green line with square markers and a dashed style representing "Consistency-Bi +beam". The blue line starts at approximately (2.5, 24) and ends at approximately (12.5, 30), showing a steady increase. The orange line starts at approximately (2.5, 28.5) and ends at approximately (12.5, 31), also showing a steady increase. The green line starts at approximately (2.5, 28.5) and ends at approximately (12.5, 31), similarly showing a steady increase.
